live_newsroom.headline: Suno replaces its AI models with a new one trained on licensed music as copyright suits pile up
live_newsroom.snapshot: As it grapples with a bevy of lawsuits, Suno said its new model, Suno v6, is not trained using music it used to train previous versions of the AI model. The story matters because AI is moving deeper into legal and regulatory territory, where product speed, data rights, safety obligations and public accountability can affect adoption.
